alternativeAuthentication.auth.js: Recovery request and completion endpoints establish identity; overlapping browser login paths are shadowed by browserAuth.js.
alternativeAuthentication.bridge.js: HRMS integration accepts a signed short-lived assertion or explicitly enabled legacy service secret and issues only a replay-safe one-time handoff code.
alternativeAuthentication.empMapping.js: The HR employee-mapping integration uses a minimum-strength server secret and constant-time X-HR-API-Key validation instead of an LMS user session.
